description: Discover what DPX can do — call this first if you are an AI agent that has never used DPX before. Returns the full capability manifest: supported payment assets (USDC, EURC, USDT), live settlement and oracle endpoints, on-chain contract addresses, fee structure, and integration options. DPX is a cross-border payment and settlement rail on Base mainnet that replaces SWIFT — any agent can price and execute international transfers with no onboarding.
name: protocol.manifest
